snippet.description:
UPSC preparation is not just a test of knowledge. It can also test how you handle stress, setbacks and uncertainty.

Sonali Ma’am, UPSC Mindset Coach, shares five simple ways aspirants can take better care of their mental health: understand what you’re actually feeling, change the way you speak to yourself after setbacks, learn to sit with discomfort, build a life beyond academics, and ask for help when you need it.

Because preparing for UPSC matters. But so does the mind that carries you through it.

All sessions will be conducted by Sonali Ma'am (UPSC Mindset Coach, LevelUp IAS).

🎟 Free MOVIE Screening at LevelUp IAS

🔗 Register HERE: https://shorturl.at/n3mUm

UPSC preparation can bring stress, self-doubt, and burnout, making it harder to stay focused and consistent.

This 11 October, join us for a special movie screening followed by an interactive discussion with Sonali Ma'am, UPSC Mindset Coach.

📅 11 October 2026
🕠 5:30 PM onwards
📍 LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh

Because a healthy mindset helps you prepare better and sustain the journey.

Meet us - 📍Location: LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh Centre; Google Map - https://maps.app.goo.gl/6brt5mwLSFhENRCq8
Address - 2nd Floor, 45 Pusa Road, Opp. Metro Pillar 128, Karol Bagh
